Config.HudNotification.Name: HUD Notification
Config.HudNotification.Description: Display a message in the corner of your screen when the phone is ringing.
Config.HudTimeLeft.Name: Display Time Remaining
Config.HudTimeLeft.Description: Display the time remaining until the phone stops ringing. Only does something if HUD Notification is enabled.
Config.ExclamationPoint.Name: Exclamation Point
Config.ExclamationPoint.Description: Display an exclamation point above the phone while it's ringing.
